1	# Project Ledger MCP Server - Changelog
     2	
     3	## v1.32.3 - Rename PROJECT_SLUG_REGEX to SLUG_REGEX
     4	- Schema: `PROJECT_SLUG_REGEX` renamed to `SLUG_REGEX` in `src/schema/knowledge.ts`; the previous name referenced the defunct `project` scope, while the constant now validates both `repository_name` and `origin_plan` fields.

     8	- Known issue: 5 pre-existing test failures in `tests/gui/api-client.test.ts` (introduced by commit 294687a, unrelated to this rename) — the test file still expects `project_slug`/`source_project_slug` params after the implementation was updated to `repository_name`/`source_repository_name`. Requires a separate follow-up work package.
     9	
    10	## v1.32.2 - repository_name Validation in DELETE and Promote Knowledge Handlers
    11	- GUI: `handleDeleteKnowledge` now validates `repository_name` against `PROJECT_SLUG_REGEX` at the handler level (after the presence check). Malformed slugs (e.g. `'../evil'`, `'has spaces'`) now throw `VALIDATION_ERROR` (HTTP 400) instead of propagating to the storage layer and returning HTTP 500.
    12	- GUI: `handlePromoteKnowledge` receives the same fix — `repository_name` is validated against `PROJECT_SLUG_REGEX` after the presence check. All five knowledge endpoints now consistently return well-typed HTTP 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` responses for malformed slug values.
    13	- Tests: Added 4 new test cases in `api-knowledge.test.ts` (AC-1 through AC-4 rework): `'../evil'` and `'has spaces'` for both `handleDeleteKnowledge` and `handlePromoteKnowledge`.
    14	- Docs: Updated project-manifest `api-surface.md` (removed "Known limitation" note; updated `handleDeleteKnowledge` and `handlePromoteKnowledge` JSDoc), `data-flows.md` (added `PROJECT_SLUG_REGEX` step to DELETE and promote flow diagrams), and `file-tree.md` (updated test file descriptions).
    15	
    16	## v1.32.1 - handleListKnowledge Scope Validation Hardening
    17	- GUI: `handleListKnowledge` now validates the `scope` query parameter via `InsightScope.safeParse()` and throws `VALIDATION_ERROR` (HTTP 400) for any non-`undefined` value that is not `'global'` or `'repository'`. Previously the handler silently ignored unrecognised scope strings and returned all insights, contrary to the contract enforced by the four mutating handlers.
    18	- Tests: Added 3 new cases in `api-knowledge.test.ts` (scope `'project'` → 400, scope `'bogus'` → 400, scope `undefined` → all results). Updated 2 stale tests in `knowledge-repository-scope.test.ts` and `server-knowledge-routes.test.ts` that asserted the old silent-fallback behaviour.
    19	- Docs: Updated `gui/api-knowledge.ts` module-level header to document the scope-validation hardening.
    20	
    21	## v1.32.0 - Knowledge Repository Scope Model
    22	- Schema: Replaced `'project'` scope with `'repository'` scope in `InsightScope` — valid scopes are now `['global', 'repository']` only.
    23	- Schema: `project_slug` store discriminator replaced by `repository_name`; `origin_plan` added as provenance-only metadata field.
    24	- Storage: `KnowledgeStoreManager.repositoryStorePath()` uses `{repository_name}-insights.json` naming; enforces `'global'` reserved-name guard.
    25	- Storage: `addInsight`, `updateInsight`, `deleteInsight`, `moveInsight` updated to use `repository_name` throughout.
    26	- Tools: `ledger_add_insight` — `scope: 'repository'` now requires `repository_name`; `repository_name: 'global'` is rejected.
    27	- Tools: `ledger_add_insight` — `origin_plan` field accepted as provenance metadata; stored but not used as a storage key.
    28	- GUI: Knowledge page `#/knowledge` tab labels updated to Global / Repository; `repository_name` filter replaces `project_slug`.
    29	- GUI: All five knowledge REST handlers (`handleListKnowledge`, `handleUpdateKnowledge`, `handleDeleteKnowledge`, `handlePromoteKnowledge`, `handleMoveKnowledge`) updated to use `repository_name` / `source_repository_name` field names.
    30	- GUI: `api-client.js` updated — `addInsight`, `moveInsight`, `promoteInsight` use `repository_name` / `source_repository_name`.
    31	- Tests: `knowledge-repository-scope.test.ts` — 31 integration tests covering storage layer and GUI REST handlers for repository scope.
    32	- Docs: Updated `api-surface.md`, `constraints.md` (§73a reserved-name, §73b provenance-only), `file-tree.md` (`.knowledge/` layout), `AGENTS.md` (Knowledge Collection cross-system row).
    33	
    34	## v1.31.0 - Knowledge Store, GUI, and Namespaced Storage
    35	- Storage: Namespaced layout `{ledgerRoot}/{repoName}/{slug}/` eliminates cross-repo slug collisions.
    36	- Storage: One-time idempotent migration to namespaced layout runs on startup.
    37	- Storage: `resolveProjectDir()` resolves bare slugs or `{repo}/{slug}` composites; throws `AMBIGUOUS` on collision.
    38	- Storage: `listAllProjects()` now scans two directory levels (repo namespace → slug directory).
    39	- Storage: Added `KnowledgeStoreManager` with per-scope store files and atomic read-modify-write via single lock.
    40	- Storage: `moveInsight()` performs promote/move atomically — eliminates the previous add→delete TOCTOU gap.
    41	- Storage: `searchInsights()` extended with `tags`, `limit`, and `offset`; combinable with full-text query.
    42	- Tools: Added `ledger_add_insight`, `ledger_search_insights`, `ledger_list_insights`, `ledger_update_insight`.
    43	- Tools: Insight IDs formatted as `KN-NNNN` in all tool responses.
    44	- GUI: Added Knowledge page (`#/knowledge`) with Global/Repository tabs and client-side category/text filtering.
    45	- GUI: Five knowledge REST endpoints wired: list, update, delete, promote, and move.
    46	- GUI: Extracted all knowledge handlers from `api.ts` into dedicated `gui/api-knowledge.ts`.
    47	- GUI: Fixed project name not resolving in breadcrumb navigation.
    48	- GUI: Fixed Dismiss button for dead orchestrator runs; unified button layout in runs list.
    49	- GUI: Fixed filter input losing focus on list refresh in Knowledge and project list pages.
    50	- GUI: Fixed backward-compat run-log route creating ghost directories under legacy flat path.
    51	- Scripts: Added `move-unknown-project` — migrates a project from the `unknown` namespace to its correct repo.
    52	- Scripts: Added `rename-repository` — renames a repository namespace across all ledger storage.
    53	- Security: Extracted inline theme-init script to `theme-init.js`; CSP `script-src` is now `'self'` only.
    54	- Security: `parseKnowledgeId()` validates IDs as positive integers; rejects floats, zero, non-numeric (HTTP 400).
    55	- Security: PATCH `/api/projects/` guard updated from `startsWith()` to regex for consistency.
    56	- Tests: 173 knowledge store tests, 30 handler tests, 40 routing tests, and CSP `script-src` assertion.
    57	- Docs: Updated `api-surface.md`, `constraints.md`, `file-tree.md`, and `data-flows.md`.
    58	
    59	## v1.30.4 - INVOKE_AGENT Action for Auto-Handoff
    60	- Next-action: `embedHandoffStatusInWait` now promotes `action: WAIT` → `action: INVOKE_AGENT`
    61	  when the embedded `handoff_status` contains an `auto_handoff` entry, eliminating the
    62	  contradictory signal of WAIT + auto_handoff (WAIT implies "do nothing"; auto_handoff means
    63	  "invoke the next agent now").
    64	- Orchestrator: `INVOKE_AGENT` added to `_SKIP_ACTIONS` — supervisor routes independently
    65	  of auto_handoff and correctly skips this action when encountered.
    66	
    67	## v1.30.3 - Clearer WAIT Reason Messages
    68	- Next-action: QA, Reviewer, and Documentation WAIT reasons now categorise eligible WPs
    69	  into "pipeline PASS (work complete)" vs "waiting for upstream prerequisite", producing
    70	  specific messages instead of the generic "All WPs either lack … or already have …" string
    71	  that conflated work-complete with genuinely-blocked states.
    72	
    73	## v1.30.2 - Orchestrator GUI Polish
    74	- Queue: Extracted entry validation into a dedicated module for direct unit testing.
    75	- Queue: Entry validation now rejects empty-string and whitespace-only id and slug values.
    76	- GUI: Refactored queue renderer, timer registry, and start-run handler as closure helpers.
    77	- GUI: Success banner auto-cleared when the Run Queue renders with at least one entry.
    78	- Tests: Added entry-validation unit tests and timer registry regression test.
    79	- Constraints: Added §72 — JSDoc closure-dependency convention for GUI view helpers.
    80	- Docs: Updated api-surface.md with entry validation id constraints.

1	# Project Ledger MCP Server - Changelog
     2	
     3	## v1.32.4 - Knowledge API Handler Hardening and Cleanup (Rework)
     4	
     5	This release consolidates all changes from the `2026-05-29-knowledge-repository-scope-rework-1` plan, which addressed handler hardening gaps and low-priority cleanup items identified in the synthesis report for the original v1.32.0 knowledge repository scope rework.
     6	
     7	### Group A — Slug validation in DELETE and promote handlers (WP-004)
     8	- GUI: `handleDeleteKnowledge` now validates `repository_name` against `SLUG_REGEX` at the handler level (after the presence check). Malformed slugs (e.g. `'../evil'`, `'has spaces'`) throw `VALIDATION_ERROR` (HTTP 400) instead of propagating to the storage layer and returning HTTP 500.
     9	- GUI: `handlePromoteKnowledge` receives the same fix — all five knowledge endpoints now consistently return HTTP 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` for malformed `repository_name` values.
    10	- Tests: 4 new test cases added to `tests/gui/api-knowledge.test.ts` covering `'../evil'` and `'has spaces'` inputs for both handlers.
    11	
    12	### Group B — Scope rejection in list handler (WP-001)
    13	- GUI: `handleListKnowledge` now validates the `scope` query parameter via `InsightScope.safeParse()` and throws `VALIDATION_ERROR` (HTTP 400) for any non-`undefined` value that is not `'global'` or `'repository'`. Previously unrecognised scope strings were silently ignored.
    14	- Tests: 3 new test cases added to `tests/gui/api-knowledge.test.ts`; 2 stale tests in `knowledge-repository-scope.test.ts` and `server-knowledge-routes.test.ts` updated to reflect the new contract.
    15	
    16	### Group C — api-client.js null-guard fix and test variable rename (WP-003, WP-002)
    17	- GUI: Replaced all four `|| undefined` patterns with `!= null ? ... : undefined` in `gui/public/api-client.js` for `updateKnowledge`, `deleteKnowledge`, `promoteKnowledge`, and `moveKnowledge`. The `||` form incorrectly dropped falsy-but-valid values such as `0`; the `!= null` loose-equality check correctly passes them through.
    18	- GUI: JSDoc `@param` prose for `repositoryName`/`sourceRepositoryName` in all four functions updated to remove inaccurate `'falsy'` language; the known-limitation note documenting the `0` defect was removed.
    19	- GUI: `getKnowledge` JSDoc updated: `'Falsy or empty param values are silently omitted'` → `'undefined or empty-string values are silently omitted'` to accurately reflect `buildQueryString` behaviour (`null`, `0`, and `false` are serialised, not dropped).
    20	- Tests: Stale `projectInsightId` variable renamed to `repositoryInsightId` across all 4 usage sites in `tests/tools/knowledge.test.ts`.
    21	
    22	### Group D — PROJECT_SLUG_REGEX → SLUG_REGEX rename (WP-005)
    23	- Schema: `PROJECT_SLUG_REGEX` renamed to `SLUG_REGEX` in `src/schema/knowledge.ts`; the previous name referenced the defunct `project` scope, while the constant validates both `repository_name` and `origin_plan` fields.
    24	- Source: Import sites updated across `src/storage/knowledge-store.ts`, `src/tools/knowledge.ts`, `gui/api-knowledge.ts`, and `src/tools/help-content.ts`.
    25	- Tests: Import, describe block label, and assertion sites updated in `tests/schema/knowledge.test.ts`; comment reference updated in `tests/gui/api-knowledge.test.ts`.
    26	- Docs: Updated project-manifest `api-surface.md`, `data-flows.md`, and `file-tree.md` to reflect the new export name.
    27	
    28	### Known issue (pre-existing, unrelated to this rework)
    29	- 5 test failures in `tests/gui/api-client.test.ts` (introduced by commit 294687a) — the test file still expects `project_slug`/`source_project_slug` params after the implementation was updated to `repository_name`/`source_repository_name`. Requires a separate follow-up work package.
    30	
    31	## v1.32.3 - Rename PROJECT_SLUG_REGEX to SLUG_REGEX
    32	- Schema: `PROJECT_SLUG_REGEX` renamed to `SLUG_REGEX` in `src/schema/knowledge.ts`; the previous name referenced the defunct `project` scope, while the constant now validates both `repository_name` and `origin_plan` fields.
    33	- Source: Import sites updated across `src/storage/knowledge-store.ts`, `src/tools/knowledge.ts`, `gui/api-knowledge.ts`, and `src/tools/help-content.ts`.
    34	- Tests: Import, describe block label, and assertion sites updated in `tests/schema/knowledge.test.ts`; comment reference updated in `tests/gui/api-knowledge.test.ts`.
    35	- Docs: Updated project-manifest `api-surface.md`, `data-flows.md`, and `file-tree.md` to reflect the new export name.
    36	- Known issue: 5 pre-existing test failures in `tests/gui/api-client.test.ts` (introduced by commit 294687a, unrelated to this rename) — the test file still expects `project_slug`/`source_project_slug` params after the implementation was updated to `repository_name`/`source_repository_name`. Requires a separate follow-up work package.

    39	- GUI: `handleDeleteKnowledge` now validates `repository_name` against `PROJECT_SLUG_REGEX` at the handler level (after the presence check). Malformed slugs (e.g. `'../evil'`, `'has spaces'`) now throw `VALIDATION_ERROR` (HTTP 400) instead of propagating to the storage layer and returning HTTP 500.
